label: Beheri

names.text: The list's Egyptian entry, read on WebFetch, gives no alternate names for the Beheri. A WebSearch result's text names Beheri as a local name alongside Baladi, Menufi and Egyptian, but calls them local names of one population, so none is taken as an alias here.

about.text: The Beheri is a dairy buffalo from Beheira Province in Egypt. It is classed as a variety of the Baladi type of the Egyptian buffalo, and its coat is slate-grey or black.
